newsitem.title: USA: Mylan gets okay on calcium channel blocker.
newsitem.headline: Mylan gets okay on calcium channel blocker.

text.p: Mylan Laboratories Inc said Monday that it has received an approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to manufacture and market Diltiazem Hydrochloride extended release capsules in 60 milligram, 90 mg and 120 mg strengths.
Diltiazem HCl ER is the generic version of Cardizem SR, an extended release calcium channel blocker or calcium antagonist used for the treatment of hypertension.
Cardizem is manufactured by Hoechst Marion Roussel, a unit of Hoechst AG.
Mylan said shipments of Diltiazem HCl ER will begin within a week.
